name: developer-hydyar
description: Developer HydYar — learning + IDE + code execution + community platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w @hydyar/shared && npm run build -w @hydyar/docs-data && npm run build -w @hydyar/api && npm run build -w @hydyar/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @hydyar/api" "npm run dev -w @hydyar/web"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:migrate && npm run prisma:seed
